request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. A real photograph of a whiteboard for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. The board shows only numbers and, where the instruction says so, one small drawing: no month names, no day names, no letters and no words anywhere, in any language. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames added, no padding, watermark or captions.

This is a precise edit of image 1: the result must look like the same photograph with one mark added. Change only what the instruction names.

Image 1 is a photograph of a whiteboard year planner with twelve numbered boxes. Keep the photograph exactly as it is: the same framing, the same board and wooden frame, the year at the top, every box number from 1 to 12 in the same place and every small grid of day squares. Do not move, redraw, add or remove any number. Add only this, drawn by hand with a dark-blue whiteboard pen, with slightly uneven ink like real handwriting: ONE freehand loop around the whole of box 12 (the fourth box of the bottom row), enclosing its number 12 and its day squares; the loop is slightly asymmetric with a small overlapping end stroke, not a perfect geometric shape. No other box is looped and there is no other new mark: exactly one blue loop on the board.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
